objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-isovalent-potential-escape-to-host
objects.description: This analytic detects potential container escape or reconnaissance attempts by monitoring for the rapid execution of multiple suspicious Linux commands (nsenter, mount, ps aux, and ls) within a short time window. The search aggregates process execution logs into 5-minute buckets and identifies when two or more distinct commands occur in quick succession. This behavior is noteworthy because attackers often chain these commands together to pivot from a container into the host, enumerate processes,
